scope.beginning: The episode begins when Hades receives the realm below after the divine division.
scope.ending: It ends with the underworld established as the guarded destination of mortal souls.
scope.boundaryRationale: Starts with the episode begins when hades receives the realm below after the divine division. Stops at it ends with the underworld established as the guarded destination of mortal souls.

characters.name: Persephone
characters.goal: share underworld rule in later tradition

relationships.rationale: Hades and Persephone shape Hades Takes the Underworld.
Hades and Hermes shape Hades Takes the Underworld.

narrative.synopsis: Hades takes the unseen realm beneath the earth and turns it into the ordered kingdom of the dead. This record stops at the establishment of his rule and does not retell Persephone’s abduction.
narrative.openingSituation: The brothers have divided the cosmos, leaving Hades with the world below.
narrative.centralConflict: The dead require a realm with boundaries, passage, and authority.
narrative.resolution: Hades’ kingdom becomes the guarded home of shades.
narrative.outcome: Mortality gains a mythic geography beneath the earth.

events.consequence: Hermes conducts souls toward the lower realm.
The dead become inhabitants of Hades’ kingdom.
The realm is separated from ordinary daylight.
Later queenly rule is acknowledged without retelling the abduction.
